title: Customer Reconnection Automation
process_description: The bot reads proof-of-payment emails, extracts the payment, and unsuspends the customer account when the balance is cleared.

must: Extract payment details from proof-of-payment PDFs

assumptions: All proofs of payment are machine-readable PDFs.
functional_requirements: Unsuspend the account when the balance is zero or negative.
success_criteria: All valid proofs processed within 1 hour of receipt.
changes_by_automation: Users no longer reconnect accounts by hand.

business_rules.description: Payments older than 5 days are rejected.
